jobs.description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

Blue Origin is building the next generation of orbital launch infrastructure, and the Western Range is where our next chapter gets written. A launch site is a lot more than a pad: it's roads, utilities, water and power, port and wharf access, integration and support facilities, and the connective tissue that lets the whole operation run. This is a civil engineering role for someone who wants to own that connective tissue from the front end, walking candidate ground, finding the constraints before they find you, shaping the conceptual design, and driving the early coordination with the agencies and A/E partners who will decide how it gets built.

You'll own civil planning and conceptual site design for the operational infrastructure that stands up a launch site. You'll build the early site layouts, surface the geotech and hydrology and environmental issues before they turn into schedule, and set the technical direction the A/E takes into design development.

This is not a construction-management seat. Most of what you touch isn't under construction yet. The decisions you're making are the ones that lock in what construction will look like two years from now, and the decisions that are hardest to walk back once the design catches up to them.

We're Looking For Someone Who

Treats a site walk as a chance to learn something the desk version can't show you
Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, then refining as the picture clears
Has been through enough of a design cycle to know where the hard problems hide
Wants to be in the room when we decide where everything goes and how it all talks to each other

Key Responsibilities

Lead civil planning and conceptual site design for launch site operational infrastructure: roads, utilities, drainage, port and wharf access, integration and support facilities, laydown and staging, and the civil scope that ties them together
Support site evaluation and due diligence. Walk the ground, evaluate constraints (geotechnical, hydrology, flood, environmental, utilities, access), and build the case for or against candidate layouts
Drive early coordination with A/E partners. Shape technical scope, set direction, review schematic and design-development deliverables, resolve cross-discipline conflicts at the stage where they're cheap to resolve
Support environmental planning and regulatory compliance: NEPA Environmental Assessments, environmental surveys, impact analyses, agency coordination (Space Force, FAA, state and local jurisdictions)
Produce sketch-level and spot-check civil design in AutoCAD Civil 3D to support fast turns on tie-ins, feasibility studies, and alternatives analysis
Coordinate with adjacent disciplines (structural, mechanical, electrical, fluids, geotech) to keep the multi-disciplinary picture coherent as the design matures
Help develop statements of work and technical scope for civil design, planning, and site evaluation activities
Use BIM workflows to keep site and facility design coordinated across disciplines
Identify project risks early, surface them, and drive them to closure
Be in the field when the field needs you: site walks, agency meetings, early construction observation as projects progress

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related engineering discipline
3+ years of professional experience in civil engineering design, planning, or site development (grading, drainage, utilities, roadways)
Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D
Willingness to travel to candidate and active sites: frequent day trips and the occasional longer stint
Strong communication: written, verbal, and the kind where you have to make the case for a site decision to a room that doesn't start out agreeing
Comfortable rapidly changing roles and priorities in a high-paced, ambiguous environment
Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident (current Green Card holder)
Ability to obtain and maintain badging at government installations (Vandenberg SFB)
Ability to perform hands-on field work in heat, cold, rain, tight quarters, or at heights

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience working at or with Vandenberg SFB, Western Range operations, or 30th Space Wing / Space Launch Delta 30 coordination
EIT certificate or Professional Engineer (PE) license, or actively pursuing
Experience with site identification, due diligence, or front-end planning for aerospace, industrial, defense, or other heavy infrastructure projects
Owner's-rep experience: sitting on the sponsor side of A/E design contracts, driving deliverables from concept through schematic
Working knowledge of adjacent disciplines (electrical, geotechnical, structural, surveying, piping) sufficient to spot when something doesn't add up at the interface
Experience with marine or port infrastructure (wharfs, docks, shore facilities, dredging coordination)
BIM software fluency (Autodesk BIM 360 / Construction Cloud, Navisworks, Revit)
Hydraulic and hydrologic modeling (ICPR, WaterGEMS, or similar)
Experience supporting NEPA and environmental regulatory research, preparation, and reporting
Familiarity with permitting and land-use coordination with government agencies (state, federal, military)
Experience with California-specific environmental regulations or coastal engineering

CA applicants is $99,201.00 - $138,880.35

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Blue Origin is building the next generation of orbital launch infrastructure, and the Western Range is where our next chapter gets written. This is a civil engineering role for someone who wants to own that connective tissue from the front end, walking candidate ground, finding the constraints before they find you, shaping the conceptual design, and driving the early coordination with the agencies and A/E partners who will decide how it gets built.

You'll own civil planning and conceptual site design for the operational infrastructure that stands up a launch site. Blue Origin is building the next generation of orbital launch infrastructure, and the Western Range is where our next chapter gets written. A launch site is a lot more than a pad: it's roads, utilities, water and power, port and wharf access, integration and support facilities, and the connective tissue that lets the whole operation run. This is a civil engineering role for someone who wants to own that connective tissue from the front end, walking candidate ground, finding the constraints before they find you, shaping the conceptual design, and driving the early coordination with the agencies and A/E partners who will decide how it gets built.

You'll own civil planning and conceptual site design for the operational infrastructure that stands up a launch site. You'll build the early site layouts, surface the geotech and hydrology and environmental issues before they turn into schedule, and set the technical direction the A/E takes into design development.

Eaton’s IS AER ITD division is currently seeking a Aerospace Design Engineering Specialist - Interconnect Products. This position can be located at either our Camarillo, CA or City of Industry, CA facilities. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only.

The Design Engineering Product Specialist serves as a technical expert within the Eaton Interconnect Technologies Division. This individual may focus on internal research and development (e.g. new technology), new product development, sustaining engineering, product manufacturing transitions (e.g. facility transfers), and new business proposals. In this role, you will serve in an advisory role to upper management at Eaton as well as to customers, industry groups, and suppliers. This specific design engineering specialist role will focus on military/commercial electrical wiring system components including connectors, backshells/connector accessories, conduit assemblies, and cable assemblies.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $129000 - $190000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical oversight to teams in the design/analysis/test of electrical wiring interconnect system (EWIS) components used in aerospace, industrial, and military applications, including electrical connectors, backshells, conduits, and cable assemblies.
Drive product line leadership around change management through engineering Change Orders (CO’s), leveraging Eaton’s Product Lifecycle Management system (Enovia).
Review and provide feedback on all engineering deliverables to the product engineering team.
Guide program teams (IPT’s) in effective requirements management at all stages of program/product lifecycle.
Provide direct technical support to customers, suppliers, internal manufacturing engineers, and internal sales and marketing teams.
Provide effective mentorship of junior engineers, and coaches cross-functional teams where appropriate.
Lead, or coach others engaged in, Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations. Determine and lead implementation of corrective actions.
Lead, or coach others engaged in MRB review of discrepant hardware and functional assessment.
Lead team in the application of Aerospace Common Engineering standards (ACES) on all projects within the framework of Eaton’s program management process, PROLaunch. Contribute to continuous improvement of ACES specifications.
Support the assessment of jurisdiction and classification of hardware and technical data in accordance with US Government ITAR and EAR regulations.
Attend and lead activities within industry group committees on interconnect products.

Qualifications

Required (Basic) Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Materials Science, or other related engineering field from an accredited institution.
Minimum of five (5) years of product engineering experience in interconnect product development, analysis, and test (electrical connectors and associate components, cable harnesses, and conduit assemblies).
Experience leading engineering programs requiring delegation of tasks to, and coaching of, peers or junior engineers.
Experience leading and effectively resolving failure investigations through use of formal problem solving tools such as 8 Disciplines (8D) or RedX. Experience presenting to technical leadership inside and outside of his/her business on these investigations.
Experience leading product qualification programs for mechanical and/or electrical products.
Experience in directing structure, design, and authoring of compliance matrices and test plans/procedures/reports (validation and verification test plans and procedures).
Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any "CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.".
This position requires access to export-controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must be a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Materials, or Systems Engineering from an accredited institution.
Minimum of ten (10) years experience in aerospace product engineering, and specifically in interconnect technologies and products (electrical connectors and associate components, cable harnesses, and conduit assemblies).
Experience using Enovia Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) software and Solidworks CAD software.
Experience supporting product launches in Low Cost Country/Best Cost Country (LCC/BCC) locations (ex. Mexico, China, Morocco, Caribbean).
Experience in product launches in US manufacturing locations.
Design for Six Sigma (DFSS/SSDD) and/or Green Belt certification.

Additional Information

Strong knowledge of materials science for metals, polymers, ceramics, and glass and graphite composites used in interconnect products.
Strong knowledge of materials science for conductive/corrosion inhibiting coatings and platings for interconnect products.
Ability to interpret and generate 3D CAD models and drawings in line with ASME Y14.5 geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.
Knowledge of CN/CO (engineering Change Order or Change Notification) processes for change management.
Proficiency in Product Data Management or Product Life-Cycle Management (PDM/PLM) systems for document control and workflow management.
Ability to complete basic engineering calculations for sizing and design of mechanical components.
Ability to interpret Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to understand inputs, boundary conditions and failure modes of mechanical components.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. new_jobs.title: Life Sciences CRM Global Delivery Lead
new_jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers. This includes supporting their marketing, sales, and service organizations. Post sales activities including service, customer success and professional services is growing in importance because of the role it plays in customer retention and expansion. Across a number of industries including High-Tech, Media, and Energy, Professional Services and Customer Success is becoming a pressing need.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30, 2026.

Work you'll do

As a Life Sciences CRM Global Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will lead global delivery management with CRM platform expertise, ensuring end - to - end execution of CRM solutions across multiple and complex Salesforce transformations for biopharma and medtech clients across commercial, patient services, and field excellence. You will shape business strategy, lead requirements and process design, and guide cross-functional teams through delivery and adoption. You will drive business development activities, craft proposals, and develop practitioners while promoting leading practices in compliance, data privacy, and regulated industry controls.

The Team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years in consulting or industry delivering CRM/engagement platforms for life sciences (biopharma or medtech).
7+ years delivering go to market strategy operations in the Life Sciences Industry.
5+ years in Global delivery governance managing clients, stakeholders and vendors across multiple time zones.
Bachelor's degree (BA or BS) or 4 additional years of professional experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

2+ years implementing Health Cloud or patient services solutions (e.g., case management, benefits/eligibility, prior authorization, care management).
2+ years in commercial pharma functional domains (e.g., call planning, territory alignment, consent management, sampling/compliance).
2+ years integrating Salesforce with MDM, data, or analytics platforms (e.g., OpenData or Reltio for HCP/HCO, Snowflake, Tableau/CRM Analytics) from a functional perspective (requirements, testing, adoption).
2+ years applying Agile delivery practices (Scrum/SAFe), including backlog grooming, sprint ceremonies, and release planning using tools such as Jira.
1+ years experience implementing privacy/security controls for HCP/patient data (e.g., HIPAA, state privacy laws) in Salesforce.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is is $163,000 to $322,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
